info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: laq0AI karanA, yudDa karanA, saMgrAma karanA

examples: 'AdityaM vosanasaM vA'vasTAya prayoDayet' (ASva॰gf॰3.12.16). prayoDayet=yudDamAraBeta. praSabda AdikarmaRi.
'SUrA iva prayuDaH prota yuyuDuH' (f॰5.59.5). ukto'rTaH.
'senAmuKe prayudDAnAM BImaseno Bavizyati' (BA॰u॰58.23). prayudDAnAM yuDyamAnAnAm.
'tena cAhaM na Sakto'smi saMyodDam' (rA॰1.22.22). saMyodDam=saha yodDum.
'yadA prahfzwaH samrAw tvAM saMyoDayati kuYjarEH' (BA॰vi॰19.5).
'bAhuByAM samprayuDyasva yadi tvaM yodDumAgataH' (rA0 6.65.31). yudDamAraBasvetyarTaH.
'yO tO karRaSca BImaSca samprayudDO mahAbalO' (BA0 droRa 0 131.3). samprAharetAmityAha.
'samprayudDo DanuzkowyA. kOnteyaH paravIrahA' (BA0 vana 39.50). samprayudDaH=yodDumArabDaH.
'yaH krudDamAyotsyasi' (BA0 vana0 268.7). upasargavaSAtsakarmako'tra yuDiH.
'na raTinaH pAdacAramAyoDayanti' (uttara0 5, candraketUktiH).
'ye ca kecinniyotsyanti samAjezu niyoDakAH' (BA0 vi0 2.7). niyotsyanti niyotsyante sannikfzya saMpraharizyante. bAhUbAhavi yotsyanta ityarTaH.
'dvandvayudDena ca mayA sAkameva niyuDyate' (kaTA0 38.132). ukto'rTaH.
'tizWedAnIM susannadDo niyudDe nAsti matsamaH' (maDyama0). niyudDaM dvandvaM mallayudDam.
'niyoDakASca deSeByaH samezyanti mahAbalAH' (BA0 Adi0 184.13). niyoDakA mallAH.
'tA (prajAH) asmA udavAyoDaMstAsAM manyumavASfRAt' ( ). udayoDan=udayuDyanta saMprajihIrzayA kroDaprayuktA vA samAsadan.
'udyoDantyaBi valganti taptAH Penamasyanti bahulAMSca bindUn' (aTarva0 12.3.29). Apa iti SezaH. udyoDanti udyuDyante Urmimatya ApaH saMGawwante.

'tAMSca sa pratiyuDyanvE yudDe rAjA pravAsitaH' (rA0 1.70.29). pratiyuDyan pratipakzatayA yuDyan (yuDyamAnaH) iti tilakaH. pratiSabdasya sArTakatAmanvizyannevamAha tilakakAraH. ahaM tu manye pratirupasargaH kevalaM sakarmakatAmApAdayati DAtorarTe tu nAntaraM karoti. taTA codAhftiBirvakzyamARABirvyaktaM Bavizyati.
'viprarUpaM viDAyedaM manye mAM pratiyuDyase' (BA0 Adi0 190.28).
'pratiyodDuM na Sakyo hi mAnuzEriha saMyuge' (BA0 anu0 148.31).

'kaTaM BIzmamahaM saMKye droRaM ca maDusUdana. izuBiH pratiyotsyAmi' (gItA 2.4). kevalo yuDirakarmakaH. Aha ca vfttikAraH-- yuDirakarmakaH, antarBAvitaRyarTaH sakarmako Bavati. (pA0 3.2.95 sUtre). pratipakzaBAvastvantareRApi pratiSabdaM gamyata eva.
'…DfzwaketuM ca cedipam. mAMsaSoRitaBfnmartyaH pratiyuDyeta ko yuDi' (BA0 u0 80.13).. pratiyuDyeta (tena) saNgrAmayeta. sopasargako yuDiH sakarmakaH.
